Gujarat.note: Official "Institutewise Last Rank of PG-2025" from ACPPGMEC Gujarat (final, after all rounds).

Kerala.note: CEE Kerala PG Medical 2025 allotment lists (Phase 1–3 + stray). Category codes as printed by CEE.

Madhya Pradesh.note: MP State NEET PG counselling 2025 (Round 1, Round 2, Mop-up). "Institutional" = MP institutional-preference seats.

West Bengal.note: WB PG Medical counselling 2025 (Rounds 1–3 + stray vacancy round). 2024 rounds are kept for comparison. Retained and not-upgraded candidates are counted in the round they held the seat.

Bihar.note: BCECEB Bihar PGMAC-2025 allotment results (Rounds 1–3 + stray vacancy). MM = management, NRI = NRI seats in private colleges.

Chhattisgarh.note: CG NEET PG (MD/MS) 2025 allotment lists (Rounds 1–2, mop-up, stray). "Institutional" = MBBS from a Chhattisgarh college.

Odisha.note: PGMCC Odisha 2025 (Round 1, Round 2, final admitted list after stray). Ranks are Odisha Common Merit Ranks (CMR), not All India ranks.

Andhra Pradesh.note: Dr NTRUHS 2025: convener (competent-authority) non-service quota final list after mop-up, in-service quota final, and management quota Phases 1–3. Convener seats are split by local area (AU / SVU); category shown with (female) for women-reserved seats.

Assam.note: DME Assam state quota 2025 (Rounds 1–3 + stray). Ranks are Assam state ranks.

Maharashtra.note: State CET Cell Maharashtra NEET(PG)-CET 2025 selection lists (Rounds 1–3 + two stray rounds). Ranks are Maharashtra State Merit List (SML) numbers. College names are the short codes CET Cell uses (e.g. BJMC PUNE).

Tamil Nadu.note: TN Selection Committee, PG Medical Government Quota 2025–26, Round 1 (26.11.2025). Ranks are TN general merit ranks. Category = the allotted candidate's community.

Punjab.note: BFUHS Faridkot PG Medical 2025: Round 1 and Round 2 (revised, after objections) allotments and Round 3 provisional allotment. Ranks are BFUHS merit numbers, not All India ranks. For upgraded candidates the new (shifted) seat is used. Category codes as printed by BFUHS (IP = Punjab institutional preference).

Karnataka.note: KEA Karnataka PG Medical 2025: non-service Round 2, final mop-up and stray round; in-service Rounds 1–3 and mop-up. Non-service Round 1 list not included; mop-up shows only candidates newly allotted or upgraded in that round. Category codes as printed by KEA (GM = general merit; codes ending in H are Kalyana-Karnataka / 371(J) seats).

Himachal Pradesh.note: AMRU Mandi, HP MD/MS/DNB 2025 final seat allocation (Rounds 1–3 + stray). Ranks are AMRU state merit numbers, not All India ranks.

Jammu & Kashmir.note: J&K BOPEE NEET MD/MS/PGD 2025: Round 2 upgraded/allotted list, ASCOMS HM/NRI list, stray round and post-MBBS DNB/diploma Round 2. Ranks are J&K UT ranks. Round 2 shows only candidates who moved or got a new seat in that round, so treat closing ranks as indicative.

Puducherry.note: CENTAC Puducherry 2023–24 PG Medical, Round 1 provisional allotment only (2025 lists were not available). Use as a rough guide. Categories are CENTAC allotted codes (UGE = general, UOB = OBC, UMB = MBC, UEB = EBC, UBM = BC Muslim, USC = SC, UST = ST, AGE = management general).

Goa.note: DTE Goa PG Degree admission 2025, Goa Medical College, Rounds 1 and 2 merit-cum-allotment lists (state quota).

Jharkhand.note: JCECEB Jharkhand state quota PG 2025 (Rounds 1–3). Ranks are Jharkhand Common Merit List (CML) ranks, not All India ranks.

Uttar Pradesh.note: DGME Uttar Pradesh NEET PG 2025 state counselling (Rounds 1–3 + stray vacancy). Govt and private colleges; category codes simplified (UR, OBC, SC, ST, EWS; PwD shown separately).

Rajasthan.note: Rajasthan PG Medical 2025 state counselling (Rounds 1–3 + stray). Ranks are Rajasthan state merit numbers, not All India ranks.

Telangana.note: KNRUHS Telangana PG Medical 2025 (Phase 1, Phase 2, Mop-up, additional Mop-up). Competent-authority (convener) and management quota. Category codes as printed (UNR = unreserved management seats).

Haryana.note: Haryana PG Medical 2025 state counselling (Rounds 1–3 + stray vacancy). "IP" marks institutional-preference seats; in-service and management seats are shown as their own quotas.

Uttarakhand.note: HNBUMU Uttarakhand PG Medical 2025 (Rounds 1–3 + stray). Women-reserved seats are shown as (female seat).
